name: VibePico
tagline: AI family photo generator for people photographed apart
description: VibePico is an AI family photo generator for families who are never all in the same place at once. Add a separate photo of each person or pet, choose a scene such as a cozy Christmas living room, a golden-hour beach or a classic studio backdrop, and VibePico builds one portrait in which everyone keeps their own face. Extra tools cover multi-generational portraits, couple photos, pet portraits, memorial family photos, a Christmas card maker with printable 4x6 and 5x7 layouts, an age filter, photo-to-coloring-page and a short animate-a-photo clip. New accounts get 10 credits for one watermarked preview; credit packs and subscriptions start at $9.99.
